name: Novotel Phuket Vintage Park Resort
short_description: A 303-room family resort in Patong with a 2,000 sqm swimming pool, swim-up bar, and direct pool-access terraces on many rooms, open since 2012.
ai_summary: Novotel Phuket Vintage Park Resort is a 303-room family-oriented resort in Patong, open since 2012, built around a 2,000 square meter swimming pool that guests and reviewers repeatedly call one of the largest in the area, complete with a swim-up bar offering 2-for-1 happy hour cocktails. Rooms feature private terraces with direct pool access, flat-screen TVs, and spa baths, and the resort adds an all-day dining restaurant, lobby bar, a ballroom dividable into three meeting rooms, and an on-site day spa. Guest reviews are consistently strong, praising the family-friendly pool, breakfast variety, and central Patong location just steps from shopping and nightlife, though some reviews note dated decor in places and advise watching for extra charges on incidentals.

faqs.question: How big is the pool at Novotel Phuket Vintage Park Resort?
faqs.answer: The resort's swimming pool covers about 2,000 square meters, among the largest in Patong, with a swim-up bar offering 2-for-1 happy hour cocktails and many of the 303 rooms featuring private terraces with direct pool access.

faqs.question: Is Novotel Phuket Vintage Park Resort good for families?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's consistently praised as a family-friendly option thanks to its large pool, breakfast variety, and central Patong location close to shopping and dining, though it has operated since 2012 so some guests note dated decor in parts of the property.
